usedFor: Webflow holds the site, pages and orders, TRIGGERcmd runs commands on your computers, and “Site Published” can start “Trigger Command”.

bestTemplate.name: “Site Published” in Webflow, then “Trigger Command” in TRIGGERcmd
bestTemplate.why: Publishing the site kicks off a command on your computers.

watchOut: “Collection Item Changed” in Webflow fires on each change to an item, so “Trigger Command” can run again and again.
